zones.visible_text:
Invoice date
NEW
Select which date Synder posts Stripe invoices under in your books — Created date, when Stripe created the invoice, or Issued date, when the invoice was issued to the customer.
New Stripe connections default to Issued date. Existing connections stay on Created date until you change them. Already-synced invoices are not re-dated.
info
The Synder transactions table always shows the invoice created date. The accounting entry date follows this setting. Sync info on a transaction shows the issued date when it differs from created.
Created date
Issued date
Apply payments to unpaid Invoice transactions
Synder applies the payment to the matching unpaid invoice.
Cancel sync if there is no matching open invoice found for a payment
If no matching open invoice is found, Synder cancels the payment sync.
Sync unpaid (open) invoices
Synder syncs open invoices to your books. When the payment arrives, it is attached to the matching invoice and the invoice is marked as paid. Learn more →
Sync zero invoices
Synder imports and syncs invoices where every line and the total are 0. Learn more →
Update

zones.visible_text:
Revenue recognition
Configuration · mzkt.by (Stripe) · invented chrome (not live in demo)
Schedule start date
Select when recognition schedules start for Stripe invoices. Set by a success specialist during RevRec configuration; changeable afterwards.
Schedule start date
Select the date Synder starts the recognition schedule from — Invoice created date, Invoice issued date, or Payment date. Changing this applies going forward only; existing schedules keep their dates until a success specialist rebuilds them.
Invoice created date
Invoice issued date
Payment date
Sync lock: When Schedule start is Invoice created date or Invoice issued date, the Sync Invoice date setting cannot be changed (see PT · RevRec lock). When Schedule start is Payment date, Sync Invoice date can be changed.
Schedule details Issued date column
Issued date appears for all RevRec orgs. Pre-release rows stay blank; post-release rows are filled regardless of Schedule start.

controls.label: Schedule start date

Pick Issued → modal open=true, select shows "created" while modal open. Modal text: "Change Schedule start date?
close

To update existing schedules, contact support so a success specialist can rebuild each subscription. Changing the setting alone does not rebuild or re-date schedules.
New value: Invoice issued date
Cancel
Confirm". Cancel → {"open":false,"value":"created"}. Pick Payment → modal=true; Escape → {"open":true,"value":"created"} (Escape does NOT close if open=true); × → {"open":false,"value":"created"}. Pick Issued + Confirm → {"open":false,"value":"issued","toast":"Schedule start date saved"}.

controls.label: Schedule details table
controls.behaviour: Rows before any change: ["sub_pre_release_9f2a | 28 Dec 2025 | — | 28 Dec 2025 | $60,000.00","sub_after_release_3c1b | 28 Dec 2025 | 6 Jan 2026 | 28 Dec 2025 | $60,000.00"]. After confirming Invoice issued date: ["sub_pre_release_9f2a | 28 Dec 2025 | — | 28 Dec 2025 | $60,000.00","sub_after_release_3c1b | 28 Dec 2025 | 6 Jan 2026 | 6 Jan 2026 | $60,000.00"]. After confirming Payment date: ["sub_pre_release_9f2a | 28 Dec 2025 | — | 28 Dec 2025 | $60,000.00","sub_after_release_3c1b | 28 Dec 2025 | 6 Jan 2026 | Payment date | $60,000.00"]. The "after release" row's Schedule start cell is rewritten on every confirm, although the modal just said existing schedules keep their dates.
